summary:
The Spanish enclave of Ceuta is reeling after as many as 50,000 migrants crossed from Morocco in just 24 hours, a deluge that left at least 57 people dead and overwhelmed a city of 85,000. Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, called it “a violation of Spain’s territorial integrity,” and the episode has stirred a political crisis, with some EU countries even floating suspending Spain from the Schengen free-movement zone. EU ministers are set to meet Tuesday to discuss the fallout.

President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing what he called progress toward “the perimeters of a deal” with Tehran. In Ukraine, the news was grimmer: Russian ballistic missiles tore into five districts of Kyiv before dawn Saturday, killing nine people, and Trump is now walking back a promised boost to Ukraine’s missile defense systems, leaving residents braced for further strikes.

Elsewhere, flash floods in China’s Gansu province have killed dozens, with authorities warning of more landslides as rainy weather persists. A tourist plane crashed near Peru’s Nazca Lines, killing 11 tourists and two pilots, and an avalanche on a Pakistani mountain killed ten climbers, including renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja. Closer to home, multiple people died in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in southern Idaho, and the suspected shooter is dead, police said.

Finally, U.S.-backed talks aimed at putting Venezuela on a path toward elections have excluded Nobel laureate María Corina Machado, raising questions about the talks’ credibility. The U.S. pushed for the deal, but the omission has left opponents skeptical that any agreement reached without Machado can be taken seriously.

headlines.title: Trump cancels planned strikes on Iran as deal progress reported
headlines.summary: President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing progress toward a deal. Talks continue as the region awaits a formal agreement.

headlines.title: Dozens die as 50,000 migrants surge into Spanish enclave Ceuta
headlines.summary: At least 57 people died while crossing to Ceuta, where 50,000 migrants entered from Morocco in 24 hours. Spain calls it a territorial violation; EU ministers meet Tuesday.

headlines.title: Russian overnight barrage kills nine in Kyiv, air defense gap persists
headlines.summary: Ballistic missiles hit five Kyiv districts before dawn Saturday, killing nine. Trump retreats from boosting Ukraine's missile defense, straining air defense capabilities and leaving residents bracing for further strikes.

headlines.title: Flash floods kill dozens in Gansu; landslides feared as rain continues
headlines.summary: Chinese authorities report dozens dead in Gansu flash floods and plan an investigation, with warnings of further landslides as rainy weather persists. Residents in affected areas face evacuation orders.

headlines.title: Tourist plane crashes near Peru's Nazca Lines, killing 13
headlines.summary: A Cessna Grand Caravan crashed into a field near Nazca, killing 11 tourists and two pilots. Authorities are investigating the cause; flights to the heritage site have been suspended.

headlines.title: Avalanche on Pakistan mountain kills ten climbers, including Nirmal Purja
headlines.summary: Renowned climber Nirmal Purja and nine others died in an avalanche Thursday on a Pakistani mountain. Rescue teams recovered bodies; authorities warn of unstable conditions.

headlines.title: Shooting at Idaho In-N-Out Burger kills multiple people; suspect dead
headlines.summary: Several people were killed in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in southern Idaho; the suspected shooter is dead, police said. The investigation continues as the community mourns.

headlines.title: U.S.-backed Venezuela talks sideline opposition leader María Corina Machado
headlines.summary: Negotiations aimed at moving Venezuela toward elections exclude Nobel laureate María Corina Machado, raising concerns about the talks' credibility. The U.S. pushed for a deal.
